title: 你的单

series.next: Season one is over. The app has one more order for you: anywhere you want to go.

setting: Your flat, a cool evening. The typhoon season is over. Your first night off in weeks, and nothing in the fridge.

chen.name: 陈爷爷
chen.en: seventh floor, no lift, with a walking stick now

duoduo.name: 朵朵
duoduo.en: his granddaughter, staying for a while

steps.narr: The typhoon season is over. Your first night off in weeks. Nothing in the fridge, and no plan.

say.en: Call through the door: who is it?
say.tip: 谁呀 shéi ya = who is it? 呀 makes it friendly.

steps.narr: You open the door. 陈爷爷, with a new walking stick and an old smile. Beside him, 朵朵, holding a delivery bag.
朵朵 carried the bag up the stairs so 爷爷 wouldn't have to. He carried the stick.

else.narr: The bag is warm, and you can smell it already. Congee, of course.

say.tip: 您 nín: the polite you, for 陈爷爷.

steps.narr: They're still standing in the corridor. 陈爷爷 leans on his stick.

say.en: Invite them in: come in, sit down!
say.tip: 进来 = come in. 坐 = sit. Chinese just puts them in order.

ok.narr: 陈爷爷 takes your only armchair. 朵朵 takes the floor, and looks completely at home.

ok.en: You climbed seven floors every day.

2.gloss: Come in and sit down, it's cold out!

steps.narr: Your phone buzzes: the order. Under who paid, not one name.
steps.zh: 陈爷爷、朵朵、刘奶奶、小何，还有骑手群的一半人。

steps.narr: The bag is heavy. Far too much for one person.

say.en: Eat it together now, or save half for the riders on tomorrow's shift.
say.tip: 一起 yìqǐ = together. ……吧 makes it an invitation.

ok.narr: Three bowls, two chairs, one floor cushion. 陈爷爷 tells the story of the typhoon, and gets it all wrong, and nobody minds.

then.narr: Half goes in the fridge, with a note in your handwriting for the riders' group.

alts.gloss: Save half, and take it to everyone tomorrow.

steps.en: Dinner for three in a flat built for one. For once, nobody has to go anywhere. Season one ends here. 🥡

else.en: Tomorrow at the depot: half a dinner, and half the riders' group asking who ordered it. Season one ends here. 🥡
